text: CONTRAINDICATIONS A HYPERSENSITIVITY TO ANY AMINOGLYCOSIDE IS A CONTRAINDICATION TO THE USE OF TOBRAMYCIN. A HISTORY OF HYPERSENSITIVITY OR SERIOUS TOXIC REACTIONS TO AMINOGLYCOSIDES MAY ALSO CONTRAINDICATE THE USE OF ANY OTHER AMINOGLYCOSIDE BECAUSE OF THE KNOWN CROSS-SENSITIVITY OF PATIENTS TO DRUGS IN THIS CLASS.
